resources.string: LUMINA

LUMINA captures call lifecycle information (when a call starts/ends and its duration) on this device only. It does not record or analyze the human content of conversations, does not synthesize \"isolation\" or \"scam\" risk from device data, and does not upload anything without your consent and a real, explicitly configured https backend. Your phone number is recorded as \u2018unknown\u2019 unless the platform genuinely provides it. This foundation does not use microphone, SMS, contacts, or social-app activity.

Audio evidence

LUMINA never records phone call audio. On Android, system call audio is not exposed to apps, so LUMINA only analyzes (1) audio files you explicitly choose, or (2) what you deliberately record from your microphone. Microphone capture is local-device audio only, is never mixed with call data, and requires your permission — the system shows a microphone indicator while it is active.
What LUMINA can capture here
Microphone: available — captures only this device\'s microphone audio (never the remote caller, unless they are on speakerphone and the mic picks it up).
Uploaded recordings: available — you choose an audio file; LUMINA analyzes it.
System call audio: NOT available on Android — no public API allows a third-party app to capture both sides of a phone call. LUMINA does not use hidden recording or AccessibilityService tricks.
